title: TokenPulse Pricing Table
description: A versioned, dated per-model rate card. One file per effective period. Rates are decimal strings in USD per million tokens.

version.description: Stable identifier, e.g. 'anthropic-2026-09-01'. Referenced by UsageRecord.pricing_table_version and ReportRun.

effective_start.description: First UTC day this table applies to (inclusive).

effective_end.description: Last UTC day this table applies to (inclusive). Use a far-future date for the current table.

source.description: Where these rates came from (URL or note). Advisory.

batch_multiplier.description: Optional. Fraction of standard price under the Batch API (default '0.5').

rate.description: Decimal string, USD per 1,000,000 tokens. Parsed with Decimal, never float.
